text:
Jonas: Hey team — requesting approval to purchase reserved GPU capacity for Q2. Proposal: reserve 4 x A100-v4 instances (120 GPUs total) in us-west2 for 12 months to cover increasing inference load on recommender and reranker. Need budget sign-off and any red flags.

Marco: can you paste the quote and current on-demand run rate? rough numbers help.

Jonas: Quote from cloud: 
```
1-year commit: $870,000 upfront (effective $72.5k/mo)
3-year commit: $2,400,000 upfront (effective $66.6k/mo)
On-demand estimate for same capacity: ~$140k/mo
Expected util: 78% base, spikes to 95% during launches
```
Assumptions: avg seq len 2048, batching savings ~18%, KV cache hit ~12%.

Alice: region question — why us-west2? we have quotas in us-east1 and eu-central. us-west2 reduces latency for west-coast customers but costs for egress are higher. can we mix regions?

Jonas: picking us-west2 because model shards we verified have better kernel perf on the hw there. We can split 30% to us-east1 for non-latency-critical jobs.

Priya: cluster health note: current reserved pools at 82% avg util. If we add a big commit, need an autoscale and preemption strategy for batch jobs to avoid throttling; otherwise tail latency spikes.

Marco: quick back-of-envelope: 1-year commit saves ~$67.5k/mo vs on-demand (~48% saving). Break-even ~13 months if utilization stays above 65%. 3-year slightly cheaper/month but ties cash. do we have budget flexibility?

Kira: finance: we can approve a 1yr if product commits to tagging and monthly utilization reports. Need budget code and runbook before PO. Also flagging cashflow — a $870k upfront outlay needs SOW sign-off.

Jonas: understood. Proposed compromise: reserve 75% of peak capacity (90 GPUs) for 1yr, keep 30 GPUs on-demand for burst. That reduces upfront to ~$652k.

Marco: that hybrid looks good. Can we add a commitment clause for convertible credits if utilization drops? ask the sales rep. Also there were unusual network egress charges from us-west2 last month — I'm opening a billing investigation.

Priya: agree to hybrid. I'll add autoscale policies: batch_preempt=true, priority=reranker>recommender>batch. Also will instrument an alert if queue latency >250ms.

Kira: conditional approval: approve 75% reserved 1yr in us-west2 + 30 GPUs on-demand, provided: (1) resources are tagged with cost-center=prod-ai, (2) monthly utilization dashboard shared with finance, (3) deploy runbook and autoscale config in ops repo. Please route final quote to finance@redwood.com. :white_check_mark:

Marco: FYI I'll create billing ticket BI-4923 to track the egress anomaly and reconcile prior month overspend.

deploy-bot: Created ticket BI-4923 (https://issues.redwood.com/BI-4923) assigned to Marco.

Jonas: thank you all — I'll confirm the quote, ask sales for convertible credits option, update the PO request with budget code, and drop the autoscale runbook in ops repo by EOD tomorrow.

Alice: once PO is in, ops will stage capacity and run soak tests for 72h before routing production traffic.

Kira: please cc me on the PO and send projected monthly spend line items.

Jonas: will do — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
